verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs point to an official OpenAPI repository (github.com/Adyen/adyen-openapi) with specs for every public API. The docs call these specs the single source of truth and recommend them as LLM context alongside the Adyen MCP server. The probe's 404s only covered well-known paths on docs.adyen.com, not the GitHub repo, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation of downloading from the repo, and a discoverable spec URL on the docs domain (e.g. /openapi.json or .well-known).
